name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Missouri - Troy MO

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance off the public road on the north side; Toyota monument sign + paved entrance with lane split.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed gatehouse confirmed in Street View (2024-09): a small grey 1-2-vehicle-footprint booth set in the median of the entrance drive, lanes splitting around it.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large gravel trailer drop yard on the NE side of the property holding ~40-55 trailers parked angled; counted from zoom-19/20 imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~14 dock doors estimated along the south face of the plant; partly shadowed in imagery — flagged as estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and generous paved width at the gate; physical room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single primary plant building plus ancillary structures (water treatment, electrical substation, smaller support buildings) — one operational facility, not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
